problem.title: Distribute Elements Into Two Arrays I

approaches.title: Greedy distribution using the latest elements of two arrays
approaches.summary: Maintain two arrays, placing each remaining element into the array whose latest element is smaller, then concatenate them. Later revisions reduce access indirection and reuse the input buffer for storage efficiency without changing the greedy strategy.

revisions.shortChangeSummary: Initial implementation stores the two subsequences separately and compares their last elements for each incoming value.
Caches the latest element of each subsequence in scalar variables, avoiding repeated last-element lookups while preserving the same strategy.

revisions.commitComment: reuse nums for less heap allocation
revisions.rawCommitSubject: rust 3069: reuse nums for less heap allocation
revisions.shortChangeSummary: Reuses the input vector for the first subsequence and stores only the second subsequence separately, reducing extra heap allocation.
